heading: What `logical: false` does not affect
text:
## What `logical: false` does not affect [LNOG.10]

- `explicit`-lifecycle schemas — fully supported; no TMS involvement.
- `ttl`-lifecycle schemas — fully supported; TTL queue and (with
  `dynamic_ttl`) heap remain operational.
- `ambient`-lifecycle schemas — unaffected.
- `activation`-lifecycle schemas — unaffected.
- Negation — a `no` pattern matches absence of
  any WM fact.  It does not depend on logical lifecycle or the TMS.
  `no` patterns are fully supported under `logical: false`.
- Series patterns and series aggregations — independent of logical
  lifecycle and TMS.
- Agenda and firing — unaffected.
- Alpha network, beta network (where rules have multiple patterns) —
  the beta network is present when multi-pattern rules exist; `logical: false`
  does not ban multi-pattern rules unless combined with `linear_scan: false`.
